request_without_reference_paths.prompt: Create ONE original standalone asset for the SAME knowledge-city strategy-game civilization as the supplied Memory Archive image. Use the image as a strict material and architectural craftsmanship reference, NOT as a silhouette to copy. Warm pale limestone, broad dark slate ceramic roof elements where appropriate, aged copper structural accents, elegant stepped foundations and restrained luminous details. Large calm material regions, warm handcrafted stylized finish, sophisticated proportions rather than medieval fantasy or photorealism. Artifact Vault: a compact BROAD LOW enclosed repository with thick pale limestone buttresses, a shallow dark slate stepped roof and one deep recessed rectangular entrance with substantial aged copper doors. Sculptural horizontal bands express layers of preserved results. An asymmetric small projecting receiving bay differentiates it from a temple. A narrow warm amber seam at the entrance, no turquoise. A monolithic protective silhouette distinct from the tiered Archive and the open Workshop; not a bank, dungeon, fortress, pyramid or library tower. No stacks of books, coins, locks used as signs or loose objects. Show the complete standalone subject in one clearly ELEVATED THREE-QUARTER ISOMETRIC view, with both front and side visible, all edges inside frame, neutral background and transparent cutout. Readable at small strategy-map scale. All walls and roofs closed except the explicitly intended architectural passage or open plaza. Windows only simple shallow framed recessed panels, never perforations. Thick connected structural pieces, no thin railings or filigree, no text, logos, people, dramatic baked shadows, excessive grime, floating pieces or surrounding scenery.

request.text_style_prompt: Original knowledge-city artifact vault, tall, ceremonial and secure. Thick warm pale limestone walls with horizontal banding and tapered buttresses, a broad octagonal limestone platform and steps, and a pale stone side canopy. Dark slate ceramic stepped hip roof with aged copper ridges and edges. Deep recessed double doors of heavy aged copper with restrained verdigris and one very small warm amber accent at the door frame. No turquoise. Broad calm hand-crafted stylized material regions readable from an elevated strategy-game camera, subtle stone variation, restrained weathering. Preserve the geometry. No text, logos, grime, baked lighting or baked shadows. Limestone matte, slate moderately rough, copper metallic.
